No leverage reapplication or separate slippage subtraction from fill-price gross

External cash flows unsupported and rejected; sampled DD not intrabar maximum
remaining_limits: Per-order adapter, not finite-capital portfolio allocator
No tick sequence, market impact, observed queue, funding-rate inference or liquidation simulator
Callbacks requesting partial execution need explicit fill receipts; no assumed maker touch
Historical model requires explicit approved execution/cost profile before FULL use
rollback: Remove additive adapter/test/caller binding; old frozen execution modules unchanged
